desc: Derive model: smoke at (R,C) at t+0.5 iff Y=P[t]-(R,C) is a prefix position with first occurrence f[Y] <= t; generation ⇔ first occurrence of prefix position.
Implement the complete O(N) Python solution with fast I/O (single pass for prefix positions + first occurrences, second pass for queries, injective int key encoding with offset 2N / width 4N+1).

Validate logic: hand-traced Sample 1 → 001010 ✓ (prefix positions (0,0),(-1,0),(-2,0),(-2,1),(-2,2),(-2,1),(-1,1); queries hit (0,0) at t=3,5 only). Edge cases confirmed: initial puff seeded at k=0, `<=` includes same-time creation, out-of-range Y handled by dict lookup with collision-free key, negative coords and direction signs correct.
